advice_items.quote: if you hang around nine broke friends you're going to be the tenth one right so if I hang around nine guys that drives Ferraris I have a lot better chance
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with successful people who live the lifestyle you aspire to achieve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 近朱者赤，多与成功人士为伍

advice_items.quote: it's mindset means everything right... that's why I don't watch the news that keeps all the negative out of my mind
advice_items.summary_en: Treat mindset as your most important tool and protect it by avoiding negative news.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持正向心态，屏蔽新闻等负面信息

advice_items.quote: when you start looking at the mirror in the mirror and realizing is because of you... be accountable everything you do is accountable
advice_items.summary_en: Look in the mirror and take full accountability for where you are and what you could do better.
advice_items.summary_zh: 凡事向内归因，对自己的结果负责

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Build a Side Hustle Before Quitting
advice_items.quote: you can take that side hustle and do it in the evenings... work nine to five... start calling for three hours in the west coast... once that career takes off now you can get out of that job
advice_items.summary_en: Keep your day job while building a side hustle in the evenings using time-zone arbitrage until it takes off.
advice_items.summary_zh: 利用下班跨时区做副业，跑通后再辞职

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: working for other companies definitely helped me learn how businesses work and be able to take some of those skills and just use them to my advantage
advice_items.summary_en: Work for other companies first to learn business operations and build skills before going out on your own.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先替他人打工积累商业经验，再创业

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.quote: I was in the car business right and everybody knows what happens in a car business right four or five divorces... I didn't want that but I wanted to be able to see my kids
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid career paths or work habits that cost you your marriage and time with your children.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不为赚钱牺牲家庭与陪伴孩子的时间

advice_items.quote: if you had a plan and a goal to make five hundred thousand dollars a year and you failed at your goal you probably would still make a hundred thousand dollars a year
advice_items.summary_en: Set an ambitious income target backed by a real plan instead of capping yourself at $100,000 a year.
advice_items.summary_zh: 设定远大目标并制定计划，突破收入上限

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: what if they had 10 of me... that company or that particular people I'm doing business with would they be happy that they had 10 of me
advice_items.summary_en: Deliver so much value that any company or partner you work with would wish they had ten of you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成为合作伙伴想复制十倍的顶尖价值者

advice_items.quote: there's no success without risk bottom line so you're not going to be safe and live in your comfort zone... you have to take some calculated risk
advice_items.summary_en: Leave your comfort zone and take calculated risks, as safety and success cannot coexist.
advice_items.summary_zh: 走出舒适区，勇于承担经过计算的风险

advice_items.quote: I believe that the personal development side has been huge I think last year I read probably 15 books
advice_items.summary_en: Commit to personal development and read books consistently to sharpen your thinking and sales edge.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持大量阅读，持续投入自我成长

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.quote: personal growth and development is probably the biggest things that I would do differently I would start doing personal development at a younger age
advice_items.summary_en: Do not delay personal development; start reading and investing in self-growth as early as possible.
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔年轻时未早点开始自我提升与阅读

advice_items.quote: understanding what it takes to be consistent... knowing that you're gonna have ups and downs I don't care what business you're in that's what you're going to have
advice_items.summary_en: Stay consistent as a business owner and accept that ups and downs are inevitable in any industry.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持行动一致性，坦然面对商业起伏

advice_items.quote: if you learn from your mistakes I believe that's one of the biggest things you can do learn that you're going to make some mistakes
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that mistakes are part of business and treat every setback as a learning experience rather than a loss.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不惧犯错，从每次失误和挫折中学习

advice_items.quote: not be scared and over analyze... a lot of times people over analyze situations and then they don't move right it's paralysis by analysis
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let fear and overthinking trap you in paralysis by analysis; take action.
advice_items.summary_zh: 避免过度分析导致瘫痪，果断付诸行动

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Factor Maintenance Costs Into Major Purchases
advice_items.quote: told me that if I buy one of those me and him would be good friends... that was something I did that I probably shouldn't have done... I should have done it differently with a maintenance plan
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid buying high-maintenance luxury vehicles like a BMW 750 without factoring in maintenance plans and upkeep costs.
advice_items.summary_zh: 买豪车等大宗消费前应买好维保计划

advice_items.quote: he's smarter with his time he puts people around him that's able to help him do more in a shorter period of time they say if you want to go somewhere fast go alone
advice_items.summary_en: Multiply your time by putting capable people around you so you can accomplish more and go further.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善用时间杠杆，组建团队协作走得更远

advice_items.quote: if you can't manage a thousand dollars then you can't manage a million dollars right so learn to manage that thousand that you have
advice_items.summary_en: Master budgeting and managing small amounts of money first before expecting to handle millions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会做预算并管好小钱，才能驾驭大财富

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年在企业界与汽车销售行业历练，凭借出色的销售与领导能力在打工期间摸清商业运作规律，随后创立自己的保险事业实现财富积累。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Think and Grow Rich by Napoleon Hill
Rich Dad Poor Dad by Robert Kiyosaki
Go for No! by Richard Fenton and Andrea Waltz
guests.zero_start_advice: 先调整心态并屏蔽负面信息、凡事向内归因；可先在大公司打工学习商业运作，并利用下班后跨时区做电话销售等副业起步，同时多读个人成长书籍并向高净值圈层靠拢。
